login.bootstrap_hint: No users exist yet. This account gets super-admin rights.
login.use_credentials: Use your Crabcast username and password.

welcome.title: Welcome to Crabcast
welcome.subtitle: Three steps to your first on-air station. You can change everything later from the dashboard.
welcome.step1_desc: The station engine (Crabsoup) will start right away; audio comes next.
welcome.step2_desc: Upload a few tracks (mp3, ogg, flac, m4a…). They land in the library and we will wire them into the playlist next.
welcome.step3_desc: Building the playlist and applying it to the engine.
welcome.step3_starting: Starting the engine with your music…
welcome.live_desc: The engine is streaming your music. From here you can tweak the schedule, add live DJs, and open it to song requests.

home.title: Radio management, in Rust
home.subtitle: Crabcast is an AzuraCast-style platform: multi-station, playlist automation, live DJ support, requests, and analytics — powered by the Crabsoup engine.
home.api_health_desc: Live check against the Rust backend (axum + SQLite).
home.api_unreachable: API unreachable — is the server running? ({{message}})
home.phase_note: Phase 1 live: station control plane with the Crabsoup engine. Media library, requests, and analytics land in the next phases.
home.fresh_install_desc: Your first station is a few clicks away — create it, drop in some music, and you're live.

stations.title: Stations
stations.subtitle: One supervised Crabsoup engine per station.
stations.dialog_desc: The engine is validated with `crabsoup --check` before the station starts.
stations.confirm_delete: Delete "{{name}}"? Its engine will be stopped.
stations.no_stations_desc: Create your first station to spin up an engine.

station.live_status_desc: Process supervision, engine control port, and the current track.
station.live_badge: LIVE — DJ on air, playlist ducked
station.recent_history_desc: Tracks reported by the engine webhook.

jingles.title: Jingles
jingles.desc: Audio files in the station jingles folder. Uploads re-scan the engine so they are playable immediately; the header Play jingle button fires a random one on air.
jingles.none: No jingles yet — upload some to trigger on air.

requests.title: Requests
requests.desc: Listener requests push to the engine request queue and preempt the playlist. Configure rules, moderate, and control the queue.

streamers.title: Streamers
streamers.desc: Live DJ accounts — each has its own source password for the station mount. When a DJ connects, the playlist ducks out until they disconnect.
streamers.on_air_desc: a DJ is broadcasting — the playlist is ducked and will fade back in on disconnect.
streamers.none: No streamers yet. Add one to hand out source credentials.
streamers.form_desc: Give the DJ their mount URL and source password below.
streamers.name: Name
streamers.connect_desc: Point any Icecast source client at the station mount.
streamers.connect_note: The playlist ducks out while you are connected and fades back in when you disconnect. Only one DJ can broadcast at a time.

webhooks.title: Notifications
webhooks.desc: Slack / Discord webhooks notified when the station goes on or off air, crashes, or has dead air. Paste an incoming-webhook URL.

profile.title: Station profile
profile.desc: Name, description and public-page social links.
profile.hls_hint: Writable server path for MPEG-TS segments (created automatically). The public page and widget then play the HLS stream instead of the raw mount.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Listeners, top songs, requests, alerts and uptime.
analytics.listeners_desc: Polled from the Icecast admin API; connections is Icecast's cumulative counter (unique listeners ≈ its delta).
analytics.no_samples: No listener samples yet — they appear every minute once the Icecast admin API responds.
analytics.top_songs_desc: Most played in the last {{days}} day(s).
analytics.requests_desc: Accepted, rejected and pending per day.
analytics.alerts_desc: Dead air, engine crash loops, Icecast unreachable and disk space — auto-resolved when conditions clear.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.subtitle: Ordered track lists with fade/cue overrides, daypart schedules, and per-playlist weights. Changes restart the engine automatically.
playlists.preview_desc: What crabsoup runs for this station's playlists (the `pl` source). Validate with `crabsoup --check` before applying.
playlists.no_playlists_desc: Create a playlist, then add tracks from the media library. With no playlists, the station plays its playlist directory.
playlists.new_playlist_desc: Pick a type; scheduled playlists play only in their daypart windows.
playlists.no_tracks: No tracks yet — add some from the media library.
playlists.edit_desc: Changes restart the station engine with the new schedule.
playlists.add_tracks_desc: Search the media library and pick tracks. Duplicates are skipped.

podcasts.title: Podcasts
podcasts.subtitle: Publish audio as episodes with an RSS feed any podcast app can subscribe to.
podcasts.no_episodes_desc: Publish your first episode — pick an audio file from the library and give it a title.
podcasts.publish_desc: Pick an audio file from the library; it becomes the episode's audio.

public.not_found: This station may not exist or is not broadcasting yet.
public.request_hint: Search the library and request a track — it plays on air within seconds.

library.title: Media library
library.subtitle: Upload once, tag it, and point a station's playlist directory at the library to play it on air.
library.upload_desc: Drop files anywhere on the page, or pick them here. Duplicates are skipped automatically.
library.stored_in_suffix: . Set a station's playlist directory to that path to broadcast the library.
library.drop_hint: Drop audio files here to upload (drag & drop)
library.no_audio_desc: Pick MP3, FLAC, Ogg, M4A, AAC or WAV files.
library.no_tracks_desc: Upload audio files to start building the library.
library.no_tracks_search_desc: Try a different search or clear the filters.
library.confirm_delete: Delete "{{title}}"? The file is removed from storage.
library.edit_tags_desc: Changes are written back into the audio file's tags.

users.subtitle: Accounts and role grants. Roles apply globally or per station.
users.new_user_desc: Set an initial password; the user can change it later.

settings.subtitle_prefix: API tokens authenticate third-party scripts and integrations via
settings.confirm_restore: Restore replaces the database, media library and station configs with the backup. A safety copy of the current state is kept, but the service will restart. Continue?
settings.token_created_desc: The secret is shown once and never stored; you won't be able to see it again.
settings.backup_desc: A backup is a zip of the database, media library and station configs. Restoring replaces them and restarts the service (the current state is kept as a safety copy).
settings.restore_note_tail: The page will reload once the service is back.
settings.tokens_desc: Tokens use your account's permissions; revoke one and it stops working immediately.
settings.no_tokens: No tokens yet — create one to use the REST API from scripts.
